mainEntity.name: What is involved in a typical bathroom plumbing installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical bathroom plumbing installation involves installing or replacing water supply lines, drain lines, and fixtures like toilets, sinks, showers, and bathtubs. It often includes rough-in plumbing (pipes within walls and floors) and finish plumbing (connecting fixtures). For a renovation, it can also include disconnecting old systems and preparing for new layouts. Frasheski Construction focuses on ensuring all new installations meet local Berkeley and East Bay plumbing codes, providing a robust and compliant system for your home.
